sql: SELECT a.community_area_name, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN c.domestic=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS domestic_pct FROM crimes c JOIN community_areas a ON a.community_area_id=c.community_area_id GROUP BY a.community_area_name HAVING COUNT(*)>=5 ORDER BY domestic_pct DESC, a.community_area_name

SELECT d.district_label, COUNT(*) AS homicide_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk FROM crimes c JOIN police_districts d ON d.district_id=c.district_id WHERE c.primary_type='HOMICIDE' AND c.year=2026 GROUP BY d.district_label ORDER BY homicide_count DESC, d.district_label

SELECT a.community_area_name, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',c.crime_date)='2026-07' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS july_count, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',c.crime_date)='2026-08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aug_count, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',c.crime_date)='2026-07' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m',c.crime_date)='2026-08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff FROM crimes c JOIN community_areas a ON a.community_area_id=c.community_area_id GROUP BY a.community_area_name ORDER BY diff DESC, a.community_area_name
SELECT fbi_code, SUM(CASE WHEN domestic=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS domestic_count, SUM(CASE WHEN domestic=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_domestic_count FROM crimes GROUP BY fbi_code

SELECT d.district_label, SUM(CASE WHEN c.arrest=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS arrests, SUM(CASE WHEN c.arrest=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_arrests FROM crimes c JOIN police_districts d ON d.district_id=c.district_id GROUP BY d.district_label ORDER BY d.district_label

SELECT a.community_area_name, ROUND(CAST(SUM(c.arrest) AS REAL)/COUNT(*),3) AS arrest_rate FROM crimes c JOIN community_areas a ON a.community_area_id=c.community_area_id GROUP BY a.community_area_name HAVING COUNT(*)>=10 ORDER BY arrest_rate DESC, a.community_area_name

SELECT district_label, case_number, crime_date FROM (SELECT d.district_label, c.case_number, c.crime_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_label ORDER BY c.crime_date DESC, c.case_number ASC) rn FROM crimes c JOIN police_districts d ON d.district_id=c.district_id) WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY district_label

SELECT district_label, community_area_name, crime_count FROM (SELECT d.district_label, a.community_area_name, COUNT(*) AS crime_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.district_label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, a.community_area_name) rn FROM crimes c JOIN police_districts d ON d.district_id=c.district_id JOIN community_areas a ON a.community_area_id=c.community_area_id GROUP BY d.district_label, a.community_area_name) WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY district_label

SELECT a.community_area_name, SUM(CASE WHEN date(c.crime_date) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-07' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS week1, SUM(CASE WHEN date(c.crime_date) BETWEEN '2026-07-08' AND '2026-07-14' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS week2, SUM(CASE WHEN date(c.crime_date) BETWEEN '2026-07-08' AND '2026-07-14' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN date(c.crime_date) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-07' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff FROM crimes c JOIN community_areas a ON a.community_area_id=c.community_area_id WHERE date(c.crime_date) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-14' GROUP BY a.community_area_name ORDER BY diff DESC, a.community_area_name

SELECT iucr, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%w',crime_date) IN ('0','6') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS weekend_pct FROM crimes GROUP BY iucr HAVING COUNT(*)>=10 ORDER BY weekend_pct DESC, iucr
